_comment: The canonical model every source system maps onto. It is product-level (the shape of a Temenos Digital migration), not bank-specific: banks adapt through mapping profiles in config/mapping-profiles. Order of record types = order of sheets in the template workbook.

CONTRACT.label: Contracts
CONTRACT.description: One row per contract. A contract is what customers sign in under; it holds one or more CIFs and their accounts.

fields.name: contractRef
fields.label: Contract Ref
fields.note: Your identifier for the contract; often the primary CIF. Used to link accounts, users and groups.

fields.name: serviceDefinitionRef
fields.label: Service Definition
fields.note: A ref from reference-data.json, e.g. RETAIL or BUSINESS.

fields.name: primaryCif
fields.label: Primary CIF
fields.note: Format the column as Text so leading zeros survive.

fields.name: legalEntityRef
fields.label: Legal Entity
fields.note: Blank uses the environment's default legal entity.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.note: Contract communication. Blank lets the target use the primary CIF's details.

ACCOUNT.label: Accounts
ACCOUNT.description: One row per account on a contract. Each account sits under the CIF that owns it; every CIF on a contract needs at least one account.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: CIF
fields.note: The CIF that owns the account. Format the column as Text.

fields.name: accountId
fields.label: Account ID
fields.note: Format the column as Text so leading zeros survive.

USER.label: Users
USER.description: One row per person who signs in to a contract. A user with their own CIF is linked; a user without one (staff of a business customer) is created as a virtual user.

fields.name: userRef
fields.label: User Ref
fields.note: Your identifier for the user, e.g. the legacy login ID.

fields.name: roleRef
fields.label: Role
fields.note: A ref from reference-data.json, e.g. ADMIN.

fields.name: userType
fields.label: User Type
fields.note: Blank lets the tool decide (assumption A-01): LINKED when a CIF is given, otherwise VIRTUAL.

fields.name: cif
fields.label: User CIF
fields.note: The user's own CIF, for linked users.

fields.name: legacyUserName
fields.label: Legacy User Name
fields.note: Keeps the user's existing login name in the target.

fields.name: dateOfBirth
fields.label: Date of Birth
fields.note: yyyy-MM-dd, or set a date transform in the mapping profile.

fields.name: accountIds
fields.label: Account IDs
fields.note: Comma-separated. Blank gives the user every account on the contract.

SIGNATORY_GROUP.label: Signatory Groups
SIGNATORY_GROUP.description: Business contracts only. One row per member of a group. A user can belong to only one group on a contract.
